statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count the actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets once and set d_T=6-r_T for each actual triangle T. If R<231, then some triangle T has d_T>=2. Equivalently, a nonempty family of positive rook deficiencies cannot consist only of ones.

scope.description: Unrestricted necessary condition on actual rook deficiencies. The zero-deficiency case R=231 is explicitly permitted.

assumptions: Counts use actual induced nine-point rook subsets once, and actual triangle subsets.

steps: Under all positive deficiencies one, every local defect graph on selected triangle nodes is a matching.
Global defect-pair graph F is simple cubic and triangle-free; actual positive point multiplicities need not be two.
Every F four-cycle has four distinct actual intersection points, even when disjoint defect edges elsewhere share points.
F four-cycles and uncovered target squares are bijective, forcing C4(F)=3D/2.
This saturates the cubic bound and forces K3,3 components.
All nine intersection points in each K3,3 are distinct by the local matching.
The component is an actual induced rook across its required defect edges, a contradiction.

hand_boundaries.name: Zero deficiency
hand_boundaries.result: Empty defect graph is permitted; no extra positive triangle or R231 exclusion is forced.

hand_boundaries.name: Two rooks sharing one point
hand_boundaries.result: Even triangle selection with multiplicity four; it fails the defect premise, showing why multiplicity-two cannot be assumed.

hand_boundaries.name: Two K3,3 components
hand_boundaries.result: Abstract cubic square equality is sharp but its actual rook realization violates the defect premise.

hand_boundaries.name: Hexagonal prism
hand_boundaries.result: Cubic triangle-free does not imply required square equality.

sharing: Root received the proposed defect-graph simplification before freeze; different-author review remains pending.
conditional_combination: Together with a separately established d_T<=230-R for R<231, the statement implies R<=228 whenever R<231. This is not an R231 exclusion or an approval transfer.
limitations: No nonempty deficiency or nonconstant codeword is forced.
No general R231 or target exclusion.
No actual positive-support inducedness or multiplicity-two assumption.
All previous candidate bytes and statements remain unchanged.
